prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of changes remains thin, as every category currently has only one test.
Predictions were mostly too high, except in round 5 where the effect was underpredicted.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder).
No clear effect was seen for introducing new flows on the home screen (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigns in adoption (adoption, redesign) or path selection (choose_path, redesign).
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -5.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Customization Mode Selection Screen: Adds a new screen before photo upload where users select whether to create a pet from photos or choose a quick styled generator. (why: Adoption has a high mean duration of 1017s and 60.9% dropoff, alongside support reports of custom pet generation failing.)
1: [home, redesign] Pet Generation Status Progress Screen: Redesigns the waiting screen with a visual stage progress indicator and animated status showing pet generation status. (why: Home waiting screen has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to dropoffs and pet rendering issues.)
2: [finish, new_flow] First Desktop Pet Interaction Onboarding Flow: Introduces an interactive hands-on step on home_intro where users practice dragging, clicking, and toggling pet controls. (why: Multiple support emails cite confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Account Sign-In to End of Onboarding: Moves sign_in to after pet selection and adoption certificate creation right before waiting. (why: Sign in drops off 27.1% of users early and causes pet reset confusion when users re-authenticate with different accounts.)
4: [home, wait_info] Background Processing Desktop Notification Option: Enables background waiting toggle with notification option so users know they can minimize the app. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, leading users to close the app early and encounter pet loading bugs.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Clarity Headline: Replaces finish screen text with explicit instructions on tray icons, shortcut keys, and hide controls. (why: Support receives frequent inquiries after onboarding regarding hiding, talking to, or controlling the pet.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Requirements Clarity Callout: Adds photo formatting and lighting hints directly on the upload screen to improve AI custom pet creation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual results during adoption.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Split Screen Path Comparison Layout: Changes path selection to a side-by-side split layout clearly contrasting instant preset vs custom creation. (why: Choose path drops off 23.8% of users and has high mean time (514s), suggesting ambiguity between paths.)

scores.note: Targeted at the highest dropoff step (adoption) with strong evidence, but introduces a new screen.
Addresses extreme mean wait times on home step; home flow redesigns previously showed minor lift.
Addresses post-setup confusion, but major changes to finish step historically hurt conversion significantly.
Reordering sign-in step had no clear positive effect (+1.0%) in previous tests.
Helps users handle the 2336s mean waiting time without abandoning the app.
Low-cost copy update resolving post-onboarding confusion without altering finish screen structure.
Simple hint on the highest dropoff step (adoption) targeting specific user errors reported in support.
Layout change for path selection, which previously showed modest positive movement (+2.5%).
